title: A novel SXXLF motif in the FXR N-terminal domain mediates coregulator and interdomain interactions
authors: Villalona P; Pulahinge T; Yu T; Wenning J; Frisbie CJ; Magafas J; Okafor CD
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子动力学模拟和突变实验，揭示FXR核受体N端无序结构域中SXXLF基序介导与共调节蛋白及配体结合域间的互作，属于IDR介导的蛋白互作机制建模，但对象为核受体而非相分离体系，方法以MD为主。
abstract:
The nuclear receptor superfamily is comprised of ligand-regulated transcription factors that contain an intrinsically disordered domain at the amino-terminal end, known as the N-terminal domain (NTD). While this poorly conserved domain is known to possess ligand-independent activation function (AF-1), few NTD functions are conserved between nuclear receptors (NRs). Identified roles in other receptors include androgen receptor (AR), estrogen receptor (ER) and mineralocorticoid receptor (MR). Here, we aim to define the function of the NTD of the farnesoid X receptor (FXR), a crucial regulator of lipid and bile acid metabolism. We show that the NTD engages in interdomain contact with other FXR domains. We also observe that the NTD interacts directly with coregulator proteins. Using mutagenesis, mammalian two-hybrid assays and molecular dynamics simulations, we identify and validate a novel SXXLF motif in the NTD which mediates interactions with both coregulators and the ligand binding domain. Mutation of the motif induces large changes in conformational and allosteric coupling in FXR. Our study identifies a new nuclear receptor-interacting motif that modulates the transcriptional activity of FXR.

Graphical Abstract

FXR-NTD regulates transcriptional activity through interdomain communication with the LBD and is also involved in co-activator recruitment. The SENLF motif is the first defined functional element within the FXR-NTD and mediates both NTD-LBD interaction and selective co-activator engagements to drive NTD-mediated transcriptional activity.
abstract_zh:
核受体超家族由配体调控的转录因子组成，其氨基末端包含一个内在无序结构域，称为N端结构域 (N-terminal domain, NTD)。尽管已知这一保守性较差的域具有不依赖配体的激活功能 (AF-1)，但很少有NTD功能在核受体 (nuclear receptors, NRs) 之间是保守的。在其他受体中已确定的作用包括雄激素受体 (androgen receptor, AR)、雌激素受体 (estrogen receptor, ER) 和盐皮质激素受体 (mineralocorticoid receptor, MR)。在此，我们旨在定义法尼醇X受体 (farnesoid X receptor, FXR) 的NTD功能，FXR是脂质和胆汁酸代谢的关键调节因子。我们显示NTD与其他FXR结构域发生域间接触。我们还观察到NTD直接与辅调节蛋白相互作用。通过诱变、哺乳动物双杂交分析和分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，我们在NTD中识别并验证了一个新的SXXLF基序，该基序介导与辅调节因子和配体结合域的相互作用。该基序的突变诱导FXR构象和变构偶联发生重大变化。我们的研究识别了一个新的核受体相互作用基序，该基序调节FXR的转录活性。

图形摘要

FXR-NTD通过与LBD的域间通讯调节转录活性，并参与共激活因子招募。SENLF基序是FXR-NTD内首个定义的功能元件，介导NTD-LBD相互作用和选择性共激活因子结合，以驱动NTD介导的转录活性。
